summary.text:
# 标本损失 / Specimen Lost

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

迷信者（Superstitious Beliefs）文明的周期事件触发：每个13年周期开始（首个周期除外）掷出吉或凶（shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415，events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221），再从 on_action 的16个等权事件中抽取一个（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789）；本事件每个帝国至多一次（国家旗标 shroud_775_triggered）。凶兆事件。拥有“大档案馆”DLC和大档案馆，且至少2个展品中有标本。

Triggered by the cycles of a Superstitious Beliefs empire: each 13-year cycle (except the first) rolls good or bad luck (shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415, events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221) and one of the 16 equally weighted events of that on_action is drawn (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789); this event happens at most once per empire (country flag shroud_775_triggered). A bad luck event. Grand Archive DLC and Grand Archive with at least two exhibits holding specimens.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，无后续剧情；唯一的选项直接生效。唯一选项：一个随机标本丢失（稀有度越高权重越大：稀有3、史诗5、卓越7）。

A single notification window with no continuation; its only option applies directly. Only option: a random specimen is lost (weights by rarity: rare 3, epic 5, exceptional 7).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支；与同一抽取池中另外15个事件互不相关，各自独立成卡。

No branching; independent of the other 15 events of the same draw pool, each shown as its own card.

对照脚本核实了触发条件、旗标、选项效果和本地化；触发链（周期→吉凶掷骰→on_action）已核对。

Trigger, flag, option effects and localisation were checked against the script; the trigger chain (cycle → luck roll → on_action) was verified.
